_comment: The corpus definition for Agent-Harness. Each query is a GitHub search. Search is the scarce resource (30 requests/minute), so keep this list short and complementary, and rely on bulk GraphQL enrichment for depth.
_why: Search caps at 1,000 results per query, so a single topic can never cover the corpus. Overlapping queries with different axes (topic, phrase, star band) are unioned and de-duplicated by node id.
_qualityFloor: Minimum stars for a repository to enter the corpus. Keeps drive-by experiments out without needing a hand-curated allowlist.
_minRelevance: Minimum weighted harness-vocabulary score. Topic tags are self-applied and unreliable, and star count is not relevance, so this gate runs before ranking. Raise it to tighten the corpus, lower it to widen it.
_budget: 12 queries x up to 3 pages = at most 34 search requests. Search allows 30/minute, so the collector paces itself and fails loudly rather than getting throttled.

tiers._comment: Refresh cadence by rank. The search index tells us cheaply which repositories moved; GraphQL is only spent on those.
